propias.titulo: Solana’s Shanghai event halted over unauthorized promotion: Report
propias.resumen: Solana’s promotional campaigns through domestic entities allegedly violated China’s crypto-related restrictions, an unidentified PBOC official told China’s Financial News.

propias.titulo: Solana Labs’ Leap Launches Mobile App for Trading Tokenized Stocks and Crypto
propias.resumen: Leap, built by the team behind Dialect, launched a beta iPhone app for trading tokenized stocks, ETFs, metals, currencies and crypto on Solana, pitching itself to traders looking beyond meme coins.

macro.titulo: Here’s what happened in crypto today
macro.resumen: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

macro.titulo: Bitcoin holders have received eCash — What can you do with it?
macro.resumen: Bitcoin’s eCash fork gives eligible holders an equivalent balance of ECX, but questions remain over where they can trade the tokens and what they can do with them.

macro.titulo: Treasury Cuts Crypto Exchange MEXC Off From US Financial System
macro.resumen: FinCEN’s order, part of Operation Economic Outcast, bars U.S. institutions from any transfers to or from MEXC, which Treasury says facilitated $16 billion in illicit finance tied to Iran, North Korea and Russia.

macro.titulo: US Treasury cuts off MEXC over alleged $16B in illicit transactions
macro.resumen: The US Treasury bureau FinCEN on Friday ordered US financial institutions to stop processing transfers involving MEXC Global.

macro.titulo: Why a Hyperliquid Treasury Firm Wants to Become a US Futures Broker
macro.resumen: Hyperliquid Strategies has applied to become a U.S. futures commission merchant, a move that could let Americans trade perpetual futures on permissioned Hyperliquid markets, pending regulatory approval.

macro.titulo: Bitcoin ETFs Bleed $430 Million as Tech Rout Tests Wall Street Buyers
macro.resumen: Fidelity and BlackRock led Thursday's Bitcoin ETF withdrawals as a technology-stock selloff rattled risk assets.

macro.titulo: Strive buys 15,124 Bitcoin in October, closes in on top treasury holders
macro.resumen: Bitcoin treasury company Strive reported $509 million in third-quarter net income and purchased 15,124 BTC in October, bringing its total holdings to 43,124 BTC.

macro.titulo: Bitcoin price dips under $75K as crypto markets miss tech-stock rebound
macro.resumen: BTC price action stayed weak after US nonfarm payrolls data significantly beat forecasts, increasing bets of a December interest-rate hike.

macro.titulo: Crypto Liquidations Top $1 Billion as Bitcoin Tests 11-Week Low
macro.resumen: Bitcoin fell toward $75,500 after AI stocks plunged, and over $1 billion in the crypto derivatives market has been wiped out.

macro.titulo: U.S. added 165,000 jobs in October, blowing past 65,000 estimate
macro.resumen: The unemployment rate unexpectedly fell to 4.1%. The strong showing surely puts a December rate hike in play, but next week's inflation numbers and the fate of the stock market could prove more important.

macro.titulo: Morning Minute: Bitcoin Erases Election Rally as AI Stocks Crater
macro.resumen: Thursday marked a massive reversal and historic selloff for AI stocks, and crypto was not immune. What held up the strongest?

macro.titulo: Over $1 billion in bullish bets liquidated while ETF flows suggest no help in spot market
macro.resumen: Your day-ahead look for Nov. 6, 2026

macro.titulo: Live updates: Bitcoin flatlines under $76,000 as stock bounce loses steam into the close
macro.resumen: The Nasdaq gained just 1.1%, while the S&P 500 only edged higher, and the DJIA lost more ground.

macro.titulo: Bitcoin steadies after AI-led selloff as eyes turn to latest U.S. jobs figures
macro.resumen: Bitcoin bounced from around $75,200 after Thursday’s AI-led selloff, which drove more than $1 billion in liquidations, as traders await the U.S. jobs report.

macro.titulo: Bitcoin holds $75K as AI regulation fears see KOSPI halted after 8% crash
macro.resumen: Bitcoin consolidated as fears over US AI regulation spread to Asia, causing South Korea to announce measures to calm stock-market volatility.

macro.titulo: Bitcoin recovers $76,000 level as ETFs shed $430 million after tech rout
macro.resumen: Bitcoin recovered above $76,000 Friday after dropping below that level during Thursday's tech-driven market rout.

macro.titulo: Hyperliquid Strategies seeks futures registration for perps
macro.resumen: The HYPE treasury company spent $785 million on tokens during the quarter and wants to bring Hyperliquid-based perpetual futures to the US.

macro.titulo: Bitcoin, Ether ETFs post $530M outflows as election gains evaporate
macro.resumen: US spot Bitcoin and Ether ETFs shed a combined $530 million Thursday as Bitcoin fell below $76,000 and US stocks tumbled.

macro.titulo: Hyperliquid treasury firm seeking U.S. regulatory nod as a domestic futures platform
macro.resumen: The company said it's trying to establish a U.S. "futures commission merchant" with full compliance for activity with U.S. clients, though the timing is uncertain.

macro.titulo: Bitcoin developer proposes ‘landmines’ to make quantum thieves lose their own BTC
macro.resumen: Anyone trying to move vulnerable bitcoin would have to put up matching collateral, giving prepared owners a chance to take both.

macro.titulo: Core Scientific to quit Bitcoin mining by year-end as AI business surges
macro.resumen: The former Bitcoin mining heavyweight plans to become a pure-play data center provider in 2027, with mining now accounting for just 7.5% of quarterly revenue.

macro.titulo: American Bitcoin’s $126M profit masks mining pressure as rivals turn to AI
macro.resumen: The Eric Trump-backed miner reported $126 million in quarterly net income, largely driven by gains on its Bitcoin holdings, despite rising mining costs and shrinking margins.

macro.titulo: Bitcoin Fixes This? Paraguay President Resigns After Bank Lockout Hits 60% of Country
macro.resumen: Ueno’s collapse trapped millions of Paraguayan depositors and triggered a president’s resignation, reviving Bitcoin’s argument for self-custody.

macro.titulo: Mercado Bitcoin Said Its Hack Was Contained, But Blockchain Data Tells a Different Story
macro.resumen: Fresh forensic analysis traces $48.6 million across 11 blockchains and finds thousands of customer deposit addresses drained hours after the Brazilian exchange said it had stopped the breach on Monday.

macro.titulo: Bitcoin tumbles to $76,000 as collapsing AI trade drags stocks sharply lower
macro.resumen: The post-election rally quickly reversed as AI stocks plunged, but cryptocurrencies held up relatively better despite a $1 billion liquidation wave.

macro.titulo: Trump-Backed American Bitcoin Turns a Profit as Bitcoin Rise Lifts Books
macro.resumen: The Hut 8-backed miner reversed a second-quarter loss, driven largely by a $197 million gain on its Bitcoin holdings.
